touches.text: Repo-root bin/ holds only the launcher itself (cairn, cairn.cmd), the one thing on PATH, so it runs even when the package won't import (5.3.2.7). Every shortcut lives in the bin/ of the device or machine it belongs to. Its bin/ plus its bus verbs is what help lists at that level (2.4.11). (Q#12: Akien let CC choose, 2026-11-03; CC kept his walk.)
The Claude Code hooks (5.10.5) are the CC device's: anything that adapts CC specifically to Cairn goes in the CC device, and every one of CC's scripts lives there (12.3.11). (Q#22, Akien 2026-11-04)
RECOVERY DEVICE (cairn/devices/recovery/; Recovery And Installation Manager; holds the host (was the System device), install, upgrades, root, Rescue and trouble tickets)

Code home: launchers/ (bootstrap.sh, the python floor that comes up before anything else) moves into the Recovery device, and superclaude (the CC launcher, 12) moves to the CC device. (Q#24, Akien 2026-11-04: "yes to both")
Owns the CC launcher (superclaude): starts Claude Code with Cairn's session contract, in its own memory-capped cgroup (Claude can OOM the box at ~12-14 GB).
For every CC instance: the CC device in the repo (cairn/devices/cc/). All of CC's scripts go here.
